name: random-letter-swap
description: Horizontal marketing navigation whose link labels shuffle glyphs in a random vertical swap on hover.
purpose: Gives compact primary navigation a glitchy, kinetic type moment without leaving semantic tokens or reduced-motion support.
bestFor: editorial brands that treat type as the visual
avoidFor: utility sites that need always-static labels
